# freetoken-rdna3

> A tuned build of the FreeToken Mixture-of-Experts inference engine for AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX / 7900 XT (RDNA3,
> gfx1100, ROCm), serving Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B-parameter MoE, NVFP4) on one or two consumer GPUs with an
> OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API. On an RX 7900 XTX + RX 7900 XT, with the model's MTP head drafting tokens (on
> by default): 77 tok/s decode at the model's sampling (57.5 without the head), 72-86 tok/s greedy up to 248k tokens of
> context, 4.1 s to read a cold 8.3k-token prompt (~2020 tok/s), up to 4 concurrent requests; uses ~82 GiB of system
> RAM for this model.

Key facts: the engine keeps every expert in pinned system RAM (~63 GiB for this model in NVFP4, the smallest format it
runs for it; each rank pins its own share) and caches the most used experts in VRAM; two cards run tensor-parallel
with an uneven 55/45 split; dense layers are int8 (weights only, lossy but agent-validated); small all-reduces go
through shared host memory (no GPU peer-to-peer on the reference machine, as usual on consumer boards); sampling on
ROCm uses a top-k-first path for top_k <= 256 and an exact sorted threshold otherwise (upstream's cooperative sampling
kernels hang on gfx1100); conversations evicted from the GPUs are kept in RAM and restored exactly. Image input is
off by default (`rdna3/serve.sh --vision`): the vision tower runs on rank 0 only and its embeddings are broadcast, with
no measurable cost on two cards and ~1.5-2 % of decode on one. The tuning is
switched by environment variables (docs/rdna3/options.md gives each default): most of it is off unless a profile turns
it on; what is on by default is bit-exact, agent-validated, or (the release's sampler rework, exact by kernel tests,
and its token broadcast, checked in `check`-mode server runs) new and not agent-validated. Precision rule: a change is either bit-exact (identical greedy answers) or validated on an
agentic benchmark (the ROCm 10 base with the MTP head scored 12 and 18 of 29 there); an int8 KV cache that passed every short test cut the agentic score from 12-14 to 8-9 and is off in
every profile (kept as an experimental option). Tested only on RX 7900 XTX + XT; NVIDIA, RDNA4 and TP>2 untested (this
model cannot run above TP=2 in this build).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, headline numbers, quick start, profiles
- [Getting started](docs/rdna3/getting-started.md): requirements, image build, model download, first run, clients, systemd
- [Profiles](docs/rdna3/profiles.md): every setting of each hardware profile, why, and how to adapt to other cards
- [Options](docs/rdna3/options.md): every environment variable this build adds, default, measured effect, exactness
- [Benchmarks](docs/rdna3/benchmarks.md): method, depth sweeps per profile, parallel agents, precision, memory
- [How it works](docs/rdna3/how-it-works.md): memory layout, decode step, split, all-reduce, prefill, sampler, RAM tier
- [Decisions](docs/rdna3/decisions.md): each design choice with alternatives, pros, cons and the deciding measurement
- [Journey](docs/rdna3/journey.md): chronological record of what was tried, kept and dropped, with numbers
- [Limits and FAQ](docs/rdna3/limits.md): RAM (why not 64 GB), VRAM, other GPUs, NVIDIA, TP>2, other models, security
- [Troubleshooting](docs/rdna3/troubleshooting.md): symptoms, causes, fixes, what to put in a bug report
- [Testing](docs/rdna3/testing.md): CPU suite, GPU checks, micro-benchmarks, the release validation procedure
- [Maintaining](docs/rdna3/maintaining.md): relation to upstream, sync and release procedure
- [Changes from upstream](docs/rdna3/changes-from-upstream.md): every modified file with the reason
- [Credits](docs/rdna3/credits.md): who wrote what
- [All docs in one file](llms-full.txt): the documents above concatenated (README included)

## Code map

- [rdna3/serve.sh](rdna3/serve.sh): launcher (profile -> docker run + ft serve; GPU choice from the KFD topology)
- [rdna3/profiles/](rdna3/profiles/): one env file per hardware setup (`TESTED=0` marks derived, unmeasured ones)
- [Dockerfile.rdna3](Dockerfile.rdna3): the ROCm image (base pinned by digest, records its commit)
- [distributed/split.py](python/freetoken/distributed/split.py): uneven tensor-parallel split
- [kernel/host_allreduce.py](python/freetoken/kernel/host_allreduce.py): host-memory all-reduce (+ `kernel/csrc/jit/host_allreduce.cuh`)
- [layers/quantization/int8_weight_only.py](python/freetoken/layers/quantization/int8_weight_only.py): int8 dense layers (+ `kernel/triton/int8_gemv.py`)
- [kernel/triton/sampling_topk.py](python/freetoken/kernel/triton/sampling_topk.py): top-k-first sampler; [kernel/triton/sampling.py](python/freetoken/kernel/triton/sampling.py) `_sorted_threshold`: ROCm exact path
- [kvcache/host_kv_pool.py](python/freetoken/kvcache/host_kv_pool.py) + [kvcache/hybrid_radix_cache.py](python/freetoken/kvcache/hybrid_radix_cache.py): conversations kept in RAM
- [moe/fused_nvfp4.py](python/freetoken/moe/fused_nvfp4.py): NVFP4 expert kernels, tuned tiles, blocked prefill
- [models/qwen4_exp/](python/freetoken/models/qwen4_exp/): Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (tensor-parallel port, PLE)
- [engine/engine.py](python/freetoken/engine/engine.py): memory planning, rank token broadcast, int8 conversion
- [rdna3/tests/](rdna3/tests/), [rdna3/bench/](rdna3/bench/): GPU checks and micro-benchmarks; `rdna3/bench/quick_bench.py` measures a running server
